description: resolve_args uses a two-phase approach: collect all (#key, resolution) pairs first, verify all succeed, then apply mutations atomically. This ensures args is never partially modified — either all #-key refs resolve and all mutations apply, or args is unchanged and an error is returned. RFC 8620 §3.7 does not require atomicity but it is the right design: partial mutation would produce non-deterministic handler behavior. A future contributor might simplify this to a single-pass loop; this decision should be preserved.
title: Atomic ResultReference resolution in parse.rs: two-phase collect-then-apply
